verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for an identity-verification service that stores ID images and extracted personal data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers programmatic access to sensitive results at a later date, but documents no retention-period settings, redaction, or deletion controls. Community worry about Stripe holding an ID database is general skepticism and does not count as evidence either way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
